_readme: Sourced from Wowhead's official TBC Classic Best-in-Slot guides (fetched August 2026), one guide per spec per phase. Phase 3 = Black Temple + Battle for Mount Hyjal (Tier 6). Phase 4 = Zul'Aman + Badge of Justice gear. Ranks follow Wowhead's own rank labels (Best/BiS first, then Great/Good/Optional/Hit-Alternative). VERIFIED: no Zul'Aman or Sunwell item appears in any phase3 list. NOTE: Wowhead's two Beast Mastery Hunter pages are long enough that the neck/ring/trinket/ranged tables were beyond the fetch limit; entries in those four hunter slots marked '[carried from secondary source]' come from tbc-bis-guide.com instead, while the rest of the hunter jewelry/weapon picks are items Wowhead names explicitly in its own guide text. Everything for Arms Warrior and Destruction Warlock is fully Wowhead-sourced. The app reads only 'itemId' and 'rank'; 'name' and 'source' are for human auditing.
